notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your continued support of "World Neverland 2 - The Waktic Republic of Pluto."

As previously announced, we are currently working to address the valuable feedback and requests we have received from all of you.
In particular, issues such as display errors in full-screen and windowed modes, and video playback on Steam Deck require major modifications to provide a more comfortable playing environment.
While we continue to work on addressing these issues, we are not yet able to provide a specific timeline.

We apologize for the long wait, but we will continue to strive to provide you with a better service.
We appreciate your understanding.

notes.title: Report on "World Neverland 2 Republic of Pluto"
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying "World Neverland 2 Republic of Pluto".

Based on the feedback we have received from you, we have made the following updates:

Implemented a "Steam Input Preset" for game controllers to enable automatic application of controller settings.
Made it possible to switch the [Auto Function] and [Fast-Forward Function] using a controller.
Added the option to change the window size to [3x] and [4x] in addition to the existing [1x] and [2x].
However, the following issues require significant modifications and, unfortunately, cannot be addressed immediately:

The game screen does not display correctly in fullscreen or window mode.
Some videos do not play when using SteamDeck.
Other requested features and improvements.
We will notify you as soon as we have a clearer timeline for these updates. Thank you for your understanding.

We appreciate your continued support of "World Neverland 2 Republic of Pluto".

notes.title: ウィンドウサイズの【3倍】【4倍】への切り替え対応
notes.content:
「ワールド・ネバーランド2 ～プルト共和国物語～」を遊んでいただき、ありがとうございます。

「ゲームウィンドウのサイズ」を【3倍】【4倍】にも切り替えられるようになりました。
【F3キー】を押す毎に（2倍→3倍→4倍→等倍→2倍…）へ切り替えが可能です。

ご不便をおかけしておりますが、皆様に快適に楽しんでいただけるよう引き続き努めてまいりたいと考えておりますので、今後とも応援よろしくお願いいたします。

notes.title: Support for Game Controller Button Layout Configuration
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "World Neverland 2"

We have uploaded a button layout configuration to enable gameplay with a game controller. By selecting "Enable Steam Input" in the controller settings, you will be able to use a game controller.

We apologize for any inconvenience and will continue to strive to make the game enjoyable for everyone. Thank you for your continued support.
